text:
eva: Heads-up: customer reported CSV download failing with 403/kms error when exporting console audit logs. Happens for org id: acme-123. Anyone else seen this? :eyes:
samir: saw one report yesterday, thought it was a transient KMS deny. Error from export service: "AccessDenied: Decrypt operation prohibited for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd...". CSV path uses server-side envelope encryption with customer key if present.
julie: quick note — we recently added requester_ip and actor_email to schema; exporter streams headers first then yields rows. If a row has null actor_email we still write empty column. KMS shouldn't affect header creation.
mike: I dug into logs: export handler tries to decrypt metadata blobs for each event to enrich rows. For customers who have CMK rotation disabled -> decrypt fails and handler bails with 403. Should fallback instead.
eva: reproduction steps?
samir: curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.dev/api/audit/export?format=csv&since=2026-03-10T00:00:00Z"
```
response 403 with body: {"error":"kms:DecryptDenied","code":"AccessDenied"}
julie: short-term fix: catch KMS decrypt errors and log a warning, then output masked data or placeholder for that row instead of aborting entire stream.
mike: agree. Also need to re-evaluate RBAC check: there is a mismatch between roles 'audit_viewer' and 'audit_export' that some older orgs don't have. The API checks for audit_export but UI only grants audit_viewer.
eva: so two problems: RBAC gap + KMS bailing. Plan?
julie: proposed rollout:
- patch export service to swallow decrypt errors and emit placeholder value for restricted fields (canary to 10% tenants) — create a feature flag.
- add a migration that maps audit_viewer->audit_export for orgs created before 2024-06.
- add an explicit user-facing error for KMS insufficient perms: "Export partially redacted due to key access" when placeholders present.
mike: add unit tests for CSV/JSON parity so schema additions don't break header ordering. And an e2e test that simulates decrypt fail using kms emulator.
security-bot: created vuln-ticket VT-2026-114 for "audit export aborts on kms decrypt failure". Severity: medium. Assigned to mike.
ops-bot: flagged incident channel #incidents for visibility.
eva: one more: we found a missing audit event type for "model-rollback". Customer claim that UI shows action but it's absent from logs — coverage gap. We should triage.
samir: opened a tracker: https://tickets.redwood.ai/issue/RI-2246
julie: for rollout timeline I'd say hotfix for fallback within 48h, RBAC migration next week, KMS UX msg in console within 3 days.
mike: I'll draft the PR and include migration script + flag. cc @eva for review.
eva: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll follow up with postmortem draft if this affects more customers.
